parsedData.logic_explanation:
• The Variant: NEB c.21522+3A>T → a splice donor region variant intron variant at exon 144. SpliceAI's numerically largest delta is donor loss (DS_DL) relative to donor gain — canonical site ablation / whole-exon skip is often the primary LOF model for a 5′ splice donor variant. SpliceAI predicts an in-frame whole-exon skip as the primary loss product (details below).
  • Clinical context: P/LP variant(s) inside the skipped exon (local ClinVar)

    ClinVar P/LP variants inside the skipped exon Matched variants (4): c.21426C>A (p.Tyr7142Ter) (Pathogenic) [VID: 936044] (ClinVar); c.21444dup (p.Ser7149fs) (Likely Pathogenic) [VID: 3584421] (ClinVar); c.21500_21501del (p.Lys7167fs) (Pathogenic) [VID: 2874975] (ClinVar); c.21504del (p.Asn7169fs) (Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic) [VID: 533964] (ClinVar).
  • UniProt: no curated domain overlaps the PTC (Ter ~aa 7175); truncation removes downstream: SH3 (aa 8466–8525), Disordered region (aa 8385–8422), Disordered region (aa 8439–8463).
  • Allelic & locus context: True alternate allele(s) at this codon (local ClinVar): c.21522+3A>G (Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic) [ClinVar Variation ID: 430110]; c.21522+1G>A (Likely pathogenic) [ClinVar Variation ID: 1679395]
    Alternate isoform HGVS (same ClinVar VID 2160710): 8 other transcript/genomic name(s) from your ClinVar record were included in literature search (not your curated NM numbering).
  • Splice products:
    Primary (SpliceAI, variant-anchored 5′ donor): whole-exon-skip from donor loss DS_DL=0.74 — donor gain DS_DG=0.00 is not treated as a mechanistic driver. Cryptic-junction “native stop preserved” is suppressed here. See the exon-skip / ORF readout below.


    Exon 144 length 105 bp: multiple of 3 — In-Frame Skip → 35 amino acids lost (0.4% of protein). (Exon 1 is 5′-UTR only; mRNA exon numbers still count all exons, including that one.)

    SOP logic: in-frame skip removes 0.4% of the protein (<10% threshold), but the deleted exon harbors 4 established P/LP variants in ClinVar → PVS1 (upgraded from PM4 because known pathogenic variation lies in the excised region).
  • Computational splicing (SpliceAI): Computational SpliceAI analysis: primary readout (5' donor / GT, variant-anchored) is donor loss (score 0.74), with the strongest offset for that term at approximately 3 bp from the variant (per SpliceAI). Scores reflect predicted splice-site usage on the alternate allele relative to reference, not proof of an abnormal transcript in patient RNA.
